name: Tewkensuchus
isnote: Described as a large sebecoid notosuchian; PBDB lists Sebecoidea; placed in Sebecosuchia.
sum: Tewkensuchus is a large sebecoid notosuchian from the Paleocene Salamanca Formation of Argentina, described in 2025 from fragmentary skull remains.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Fragmentary skull remains from the Salamanca Formation.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Bravo et al. 2025
